title: Mark the two register sections that document deferral machinery, and write the marker down
action: Apply the marker dds-1 shipped, and document it. (1) docs/handbook/register.md — wrap the '### `.bee/deferred-queue.jsonl`' section and the '### `.bee/capture-queue.jsonl`' section in the reasoned marker. Give each its own honest reason, not boilerplate: these sections name and describe the deferral queues themselves, so the word is the subject matter rather than a promise to act later. Wrap the whole section including its heading — the heading is one of the blocking lines, because its backtick span is a filename the door tries to resolve as a trigger id. Do NOT wrap anything else, and do NOT reword the prose to dodge the matcher; the point is to name the exemption, not to hide from it. Verify the result by running bee close --feature doc-deferral-scope --dry-run --json with the NEWLY BUILT binary and confirming the doc-deferral door no longer names any docs/handbook/register.md line. (2) Document the marker where a reader will meet it. register.md's own doc-deferral / close-doors material is the first home; docs/config-reference.md only if that file already covers close doors — check before writing, and if it does not, say so and skip part 2's second half rather than inventing a section. State the exact syntax, that the reason is required and a reasonless marker exempts nothing, and that it is for prose that DOCUMENTS deferral rather than prose that defers.
verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml && ./packages/bee-rs/target/release/bee close --feature doc-deferral-scope --dry-run --json && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test pointer_integrity
done_when: The two register sections that document the deferral and capture queues carry reasoned markers with their own honest reasons; bee close --dry-run with the newly built binary names no docs/handbook/register.md line in its doc-deferral door; the marker's syntax and its reason-required rule are written down where a reader meets close doors; no prose was reworded to dodge the matcher; pointer-integrity is green.
notes: Phase 2. Depends on dds-1 shipping the marker syntax.
